# The Grid Asia

> > The Grid Asia is a luxury lifestyle publication covering supercars, yachts, travel, and premium experiences across Asia-Pacific.

The Grid Asia features automotive excellence from brands like Ferrari, Porsche, Lamborghini, and BMW, alongside superyacht showcases from builders like Benetti and Sunseeker. The publication also covers luxury travel destinations, hospitality, and sustainable mobility innovations across Malaysia, Singapore, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Supercars & Performance Vehicles
- Ferrari, Porsche, Lamborghini, Aston Martin
- Superyachts & Luxury Vessels
- Benetti, Sunseeker Yachts
- Sustainable & Electro Mobility
- BMW Group Malaysia Innovations
- Luxury Travel & Safari Experiences
- Malaysia & Asia-Pacific Markets
- Yacht Design & Marine Excellence
- Classic Car Restoration
- Premium Hospitality & Real Estate
- Automotive Heritage & Anniversaries

## Automotive & Supercars

- [Dieter Knechtel Explains Why Ferrari Is The Best](https://thegridasia.com/dieter-knechtel-explains-why-ferrari-is-the-best): Ferrari Asia-Pacific CEO Dieter Knechtel on 70th anniversary & LaFerrari
- [A Vintage Cruise In Commemoration Of Lamborghini's 60th Anniversary](https://thegridasia.com/a-vintage-cruise-in-commemoration-of-lamborghinis-60th-anniversary): Lamborghini 60th anniversary vintage supercar cruise featuring Miura & 400GT
- [Making Sense Of A New Turbocharging Era](https://thegridasia.com/making-sense-of-a-new-turbocharging-era): Porsche 718 Cayman & Boxster turbo era review at Sepang Circuit
- [A Taste of Speed: Aston Martin Unleashes Its Fastest Vantage Yet in Malaysia](https://thegridasia.com/a-taste-of-speed-aston-martin-unleashes-its-fastest-vantage-yet-in-malaysia): Aston Martin Vantage launch in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- [Restoration Is The Name Of The Game](https://thegridasia.com/singer-porsche-911-964-cabriolet-restoration): Singer's Porsche 911 964 Cabriolet & 930 Turbo restoration showcase
- [Porsche Sunday Drives: Iceland](https://thegridasia.com/porsche-sunday-drives-iceland): Bjarni Elvar Pétursson's Porsche Taycan Turbo S drives in Iceland
